title: Air Fryer Maple Chipotle Pork Chops
ingredients: Dry Rub: 3 tbsp chipotle chile powder
Maple Sauce: 6 tbsp pure maple syrup
3 tbsp adobo sauce (from a can of chipotle in adobo sauce)
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375°F for 5 minutes.
Make the dry rub: Stir together the chipotle chile powder, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and black pepper in a small bowl.
Coat the pork: Dry the pork chops thoroughly with paper towels and rub all sides evenly with the vegetable oil. Sprinkle the chops evenly with the chile powder mixture, rubbing until well coated.

Cook in batches: Work in batches of 2 to 3 chops, depending on basket size. Add chops to the air fryer basket and cook 8 minutes. Turn the chops and continue cooking until a digital thermometer inserted into the thickest portion registers 145°F, about 6 to 8 minutes more.
Rest: Remove the chops from the air fryer and rest on a cutting board 5 minutes. Repeat with remaining batches.
Make the maple sauce: While the pork rests, stir together the maple syrup, adobo sauce and apple cider vinegar in a small bowl.
Serve: Thinly slice the pork chops against the grain, drizzle with the maple sauce and sprinkle with scallions. Serve immediately.
notes: Serving = 1 chop. Nutrition is an approximate estimate per serving, based on 6 servings and 12-oz bone-in chops. Sodium is largely from the salt and dry rub; adjust to taste.
